# Dalia McMillan

> Solution Focused Hypnotherapy with Dalia McMillan — in person in Hassocks, Lewes, Brighton and the surrounding villages, and online.

## Overview

Dalia McMillan is a Solution Focused Hypnotherapist trained with CPHT and a member of AfSFH, fully insured and enhanced DBS checked. With 28 years in therapeutic and wellbeing practice — and over ten years working with young people as a teacher — she works with adults, teenagers and children. Sessions blend talking therapy with a deeply relaxing trance state, drawing on neuroscience, psychotherapy, NLP and CBT to help people ease anxiety, lift low mood, break habits and addictions, sleep better, and feel more like themselves again.
